title: Claude Code MCP server configuration (.mcp.json)
description: MCP server configuration for a Claude Code plugin: the contents of .mcp.json at the plugin root, either a map of server name to server config wrapped in "mcpServers", or that map with the wrapper omitted. The same map is accepted inline as plugin.json's mcpServers (plugin.schema.json references $defs/mcpServersMap).
$comment: POLICY: stricter than Claude Code. Every server entry closes its keys per transport, because this repository authors these files and a typo the CLI silently ignores is a bug. Measured on 2.1.310: claude plugin validate --strict accepts an unknown key in a server entry with no message, and the engine (zod object, not strict) drops it at load. Keys the engine reads but the docs do not name carry x-docs-status: cli-only. @internal engine keys (role, request_timeout_ms) stay out. The root has no $schema property: with the wrapper omitted every top-level key is a server name, and validate --strict passes a $schema beside mcpServers, so it is no guard either. Associate this schema through editor settings (json.schemas), never through a key inside the file.

mcpServersMap.title: MCP server map
mcpServersMap.description: Map of server name to server configuration. A plugin's server registers as plugin:<plugin>:<server> and its tools as mcp__plugin_<plugin>_<server>__<tool>. A server declared later replaces an earlier one with the same name.

propertyNames.description: Letters, digits, hyphens and underscores, not a JavaScript object member name (engine 2.1.310).

mcpServerConfig.title: MCP server
mcpServerConfig.description: One MCP server, by transport. An entry with a url and no type is a configuration error: Claude Code reads a typeless entry as stdio, skips it and reports 'MCP server "<name>" has a "url" but no "type"'. A "type": "sdk" entry is skipped in files: only an SDK host application can register one.

stdioServer.title: stdio server
stdioServer.description: A local process Claude Code starts and talks to over stdin and stdout.

type.description: Optional; stdio is the default when type is absent.

command.description: Executable to start. Expands ${VAR} and ${VAR:-default}; in a plugin also ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}, ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA} and ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}.

args.description: Arguments, each passed as one argument with no quoting. Same expansion as command.

env.description: Environment of the server process. Same expansion as command. claude mcp get prints a plugin server's values as NAME=[REDACTED].

httpServer.title: HTTP server
httpServer.description: A remote server over streamable HTTP.

type.description: streamable-http is an alias for http, the name the MCP specification uses.

sseServer.title: SSE server
sseServer.description: A remote server over Server-Sent Events. The SSE transport is deprecated: use an HTTP server where available.

wsServer.title: WebSocket server
wsServer.description: A remote server over WebSocket. Authentication is header-only (headers or headersHelper); claude mcp add --transport does not accept ws, so it is configured in JSON only.

url.description: Endpoint of the server. Expands ${VAR} and ${VAR:-default}; in a plugin also the path placeholders. claude.ai and Cowork can offer a remote https server to the user as a connector; a stdio server never reaches them.

headers.description: Static HTTP headers, such as a bearer token. Values expand ${VAR}; a plugin may use ${user_config.KEY} here. Since 2.1.299 the configured headers except Authorization are also sent on OAuth sign-in, refresh and revocation to the server's origin.

headersHelper.description: Command that prints the headers as one JSON object, merged into the connection headers at connect time, for a credential that expires. Runs through a shell, so a plugin's helper cannot reference ${user_config.*}; for a project .mcp.json it runs only after the folder is trusted.

oauth.title: OAuth
oauth.description: OAuth settings for a remote server.

clientId.description: Pre-registered OAuth client ID; the secret is entered with claude mcp add --client-secret, never stored in this file.

callbackPort.description: Fixed OAuth callback port; alone it keeps dynamic client registration.

authServerMetadataUrl.description: Authorization server metadata URL that bypasses discovery. Must use https://; its scopes_supported overrides the scopes the server advertises.

scopes.description: Space-separated scopes to request (RFC 6749 §3.3); takes precedence over authServerMetadataUrl and discovery. offline_access is appended when the server advertises it.

xaa.description: Read by the engine; not in the docs.

toolTimeout.description: Hard wall-clock limit per tool call, in milliseconds; overrides MCP_TOOL_TIMEOUT for this server. Values below 1000 are ignored and fall through to MCP_TOOL_TIMEOUT. Progress notifications do not extend it.

alwaysLoad.description: true loads the server's tools upfront regardless of ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH; false keeps every tool deferred behind tool search, including tools whose author marked _meta['anthropic/alwaysLoad'] true (2.1.287). Omitted, tools marked by their author load upfront.

toolPolicies.description: Per-tool permission policies. Read by the engine; not in the docs.

toolPermissions.description: Tool name to allow, ask or blocked. Read by the engine; not in the docs.

discoveryCache.description: Read by the engine; not in the docs.

bareElicitationCapability.description: true makes Claude Code announce the elicitation capability without URL prompts, for a server that stops connecting after URL prompts arrived (2025-11-25 protocol). Not in the docs.

x-verified.engine: zod schemas in @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk 0.3.310, read as text
x-verified.oracle: claude plugin validate --strict --json on one-change fixture plugins
